python -c "
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '.')

# Monkey-patch _generate_expression to add debugging
import parse

original_gen = parse.Parser._generate_expression

def debug_gen(self):
    depth = 0
    i = 0
    fmt = self._format
    print(f'Validating format: {repr(fmt)}')
    while i < len(fmt):
        if fmt[i:i+2] == '{{':
            print(f'  i={i}: {{ -> skip')
            i += 2
        elif fmt[i:i+2] == '}}':
            print(f'  i={i}: }} -> skip')
            i += 2
        elif fmt[i] == '{':
            print(f'  i={i}: {{ -> depth={depth}+1')
            depth += 1
            i += 1
        elif fmt[i] == '}':
            print(f'  i={i}: }} -> depth={depth}')
            if depth > 0:
                depth -= 1
                i += 1
            else:
                raise ValueError('single } in format')
        else:
            i += 1
    print(f'Final depth: {depth}')
    if depth != 0:
        raise ValueError('single { in format string')
    
    return original_gen(self)

parse.Parser._generate_expression = debug_gen

p = parse.Parser('{}')
print(p._expression)
"
